big-mo-s-may-initial-dialogue.npc: The name is Big Mo. I'm a travelling salesman and businessman from overseas.
I drop by these parts every so often to see what wares I can get my hands on.

big-mo-s-may-initial-dialogue.player: What do you mean by 'overseas'? Karamja?

big-mo-s-may-initial-dialogue.npc: Ha! It seems you've got a lot of the world left to explore. hey, maybe I could help you with that.

steps.npc: When I buy stock, I buy almost everything I can get my hands on. I always end up finding clue scrolls mixed in with my stock.
Usually my little brother would follow up on them, often coming back with a big pile of loot.
Unfortunately, my brother got wrapped up in some nasty dealings with some faulty dragon claws so we had to part ways.
Since you seem interested in an adventure, you seem like the perfect [man/woman] for the job!

steps.player: So... You would give me a clue scroll and we would split the loot once I find it?

steps.npc: Not quite. I'm sure you're a lovely chap and all, but I can't trust a stranger!
I'd be more than happy to cut you a deal. I can sell you any clue scrolls I come across for 50gp.
I'm sure you'd make a killing on any loot you find.

options.text: Why don't you do the clue scrolls yourself?

steps.player: Why don't you do the clue scrolls yourself? Wouldn't you make more money?

steps.npc: HA! Sure, the guy in the 50,000,000 coin suit is going to run around all day digging holes. Come on! Now, do you want to buy one?
Okay, they're 50 coins each. How much of a challenge would you like? I'll take a look and see if I have a clue fitting for your experience.
Perfect! I've got just the clue right here. Pleasure doing business with you!

steps.text: Player receives an easy clue scroll.

steps.npc: If you can track me down again another day I will do my best to have the perfect clue for you. Good luck.

The name is Big Mo. I was a travelling salesman and businessman, passing through the towns to see what wares I could get my hands on.
I turned up a few years ago, selling clue scrolls to encourage people to explore. I'd only sell each person one clue scroll per day, of course.
HA HA HA! I deliberately didn't tell people where I was from. Mostly they assumed me to be from Zeah.
That may or may not be true, though - no-one else in Zeah looks much like me. I'll leave it as a mystery...
